text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for summer camp, a place where runners train to improve their skills, but Seiun Sky is only interested in fishing in the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even with her rivals working hard, she declares she's going to fish first and heads off to a rocky beach.
